method.conditions: new CLI processes; warmed OS filesystem/executable caches; no cache flushing
method.cli_timing: spawn to exit, includes launcher/capture and complete stdout; preparation excluded
method.percentiles: nearest rank p95/p99; conventional median p50
method.safety: temporary fixture/cache directories; no Git execution or external service calls

native_pipe_roundtrip_us.includes: two OS pipes + persistent cat + Python read/write + scheduling; no startup

first_byte_ms.note: Execute buffers finite terminal output until completion; shell streams it immediately. Not an event-worker benchmark.

scripts.small.program:
read "small.txt"
pipe to tr with from "[:lower:]" and to "[:upper:]"
pipe to wc with flags ["-l"]
scripts.large.program:
read "large.txt"
pipe to tr with from "[:lower:]" and to "[:upper:]"
pipe to wc with flags ["-l"]
scripts.copy.program:
read "large.txt"
pipe to tr with from "[:lower:]" and to "[:upper:]"
pipe to cat
scripts.uncached.program:
read "large.txt"
then tr with from "[:lower:]" and to "[:upper:]"
then wc with flags ["-l"]
scripts.cached.program:
read "large.txt"
then tr with from "[:lower:]" and to "[:upper:]" and cache
then wc with flags ["-l"]
